FisicaBit.leerSensorInterno|block: Reads an internal micro:bit sensor and returns its value.
FisicaBit.leerSensorAnalogico|block: Reads an analog sensor connected to a pin (0-1023).
FisicaBit.medirDistanciaUltrasonido|bloc: Measures distance with an HC-SR04 ultrasonic sensor.
FisicaBit.fijarUmbralBarrera|block: Sets the threshold for an analog optical barrier.
FisicaBit.leerBarreraCrudo|block: Reads the raw value from a barrier sensor for calibration.
FisicaBit.barreraActivada|block: Checks if an optical barrier is triggered.
FisicaBit.medirTiempoBarrera|block: Measures transit time between two barriers (TypeScript, ~1ms).
FisicaBit.medirTiempoBarreraNativo|block: Measures transit time between two barriers (C++ native, ~1μs).
FisicaBit.calcularVelocidad|block: Calculates velocity from time and distance.
FisicaBit.medirTiempoBloqueo|block: Measures how long an object blocks a barrier.
FisicaBit.convertirTemperatura|block: Converts temperature between Celsius, Fahrenheit, and Kelvin.
FisicaBit.mapearValor|block: Maps a value from one range to another.
FisicaBit.medirPulsoNativo|block: Measures pulse duration with microsecond precision.
FisicaBit.leerADCPromedio|block: Reads ADC with oversampling to reduce noise.
FisicaBit.mostrarEnLED|block: Shows a label and value on the LED display.
FisicaBitSerial.enviar1|block: Sends the micro:bit time (ms) and one measured value to fisicabit.com over USB, then waits until the next sample. Place inside "forever". Line sent: time,value. Example: acceleration x every 100 ms = 10 samples per second.
FisicaBitSerial.enviar1|param|valor: Value to send (sensor, variable or calculation)
FisicaBitSerial.enviar2|block: Sends the micro:bit time and two measured values to fisicabit.com over USB, then waits until the next sample. Line: time,value1,value2.
FisicaBitSerial.enviar3|block: Sends the micro:bit time and three measured values to fisicabit.com over USB, then waits until the next sample. Line: time,value1,value2,value3.
FisicaBitSerial.enviar4|block: Sends the micro:bit time and four measured values to fisicabit.com over USB, then waits until the next sample.
FisicaBitSerial.fijarFrecuencia|block: Sets the default interval for send blocks (normally not needed: the send block has its own "every ... ms").
FisicaBitSerial.fijarIntervalo|block: Sets the interval between samples in milliseconds.
FisicaBitSerial.bucleMuestreo|block: Fast loop for fisicabit.com: runs the inner code every X ms with precise timing, without the hidden delay of "forever". Use instead of "forever" for 50-100 Hz. Put the send block inside; its "every ... ms" is ignored inside the loop.
FisicaBitSerial.bucleMuestreo|param|cuer: Code to run on each sample
FisicaBitSerial.tiempoSerial|block: Time in milliseconds since USB streaming started (starts at 0).
FisicaBitSerial.enviarTimestamp|block: Enables or disables sending the micro:bit time as the first column. Must match the "Micro:bit sends timestamp" option on fisicabit.com.
FisicaBitSerial.enviarTimestamp|param|ac: true = send time (default), false = values only
FisicaBitSerial.fijarDecimales|block: Number of decimals used for non-integer values.
FisicaBitSerial.enviarLinea|block: Sends a free text line over USB.
FisicaBitBT.inicioRapido|block: Starts Bluetooth ready to connect to fisicabit.com. Place in "on start" as the first block.
FisicaBitBT.enviar1|block: Sends the micro:bit time (ms) and one measured value to fisicabit.com via Bluetooth, then waits until the next sample. Only transmits while the page is connected. Line: time,value. Recommended 50 ms or more.
FisicaBitBT.enviar1|param|valor: Value to send (sensor, variable or calculation)
FisicaBitBT.enviar2|block: Sends the micro:bit time and two measured values to fisicabit.com via Bluetooth, then waits until the next sample.
FisicaBitBT.enviar3|block: Sends the micro:bit time and three measured values to fisicabit.com via Bluetooth, then waits until the next sample.
FisicaBitBT.enviar4|block: Sends the micro:bit time and four measured values to fisicabit.com via Bluetooth, then waits until the next sample.
FisicaBitBT.fijarFrecuencia|block: Sets the default interval for Bluetooth send blocks (normally not needed: the send block has its own "every ... ms").
FisicaBitBT.estaConectado|block: True while fisicabit.com is connected via Bluetooth.
FisicaBitBT.alConectar|block: Runs the code when fisicabit.com connects via Bluetooth.
FisicaBitBT.alDesconectar|block: Runs the code when fisicabit.com disconnects from Bluetooth.
FisicaBitBT.mostrarIconos|block: Enables or disables the status icons on the LED display (target = waiting, heart = connected).
FisicaBitBT.fijarIntervalo|block: Sets the interval between samples in milliseconds.
FisicaBitBT.bucleMuestreo|block: Fast loop for fisicabit.com via Bluetooth: runs the inner code every X ms with precise timing. Put the send block inside; its "every ... ms" is ignored inside the loop. 50 ms or more recommended over Bluetooth.
FisicaBitBT.bucleMuestreo|param|cuerpo: Code to run on each sample
FisicaBitBT.tiempo|block: Time in milliseconds since the last Bluetooth connection (starts at 0).
FisicaBitBT.enviarTimestamp|block: Enables or disables sending the micro:bit time as the first column. Must match the "Micro:bit sends timestamp" option on fisicabit.com.
FisicaBitBT.fijarDecimales|block: Number of decimals used for non-integer values. Fewer decimals = smoother Bluetooth.
FisicaBitBT.enviarTexto|block: Sends a free text line via Bluetooth.
FisicaBitBT.inicioCompleto|block: Starts Bluetooth with UART and all native BLE services. Each extra service slows down the connection.
FisicaBitBT.configurarIndicadorConexion|: (Deprecated) "start Bluetooth for fisicabit.com" already shows the icons.
FisicaBitSerial.enviar1|param|ms: Time between samples in ms (100 = 10 per second), eg: 100
FisicaBitSerial.enviar2|param|ms: Time between samples in ms, eg: 100
FisicaBitSerial.enviar3|param|ms: Time between samples in ms, eg: 100
FisicaBitSerial.enviar4|param|ms: Time between samples in ms, eg: 100
FisicaBitSerial.bucleMuestreo|param|ms: Time between samples in ms (20 = 50 per second, 10 = 100 per second), eg: 20
FisicaBitBT.enviar1|param|ms: Time between samples in ms (100 = 10 per second), eg: 100
FisicaBitBT.enviar2|param|ms: Time between samples in ms, eg: 100
FisicaBitBT.enviar3|param|ms: Time between samples in ms, eg: 100
FisicaBitBT.enviar4|param|ms: Time between samples in ms, eg: 100
FisicaBitBT.bucleMuestreo|param|ms: Time between samples in ms, eg: 50
FisicaBitSerial.enviarSinTiempo1|block: Sends only one measured value to fisicabit.com over USB, without the micro:bit time and without waiting: it is sent the moment the block runs. Use it on a button press or inside "forever" with your own pause. On fisicabit.com: "Micro:bit sends timestamp" disabled.
